text:
morgan: Quick alert 23: noticed some orgs getting duplicate quota hits when requests route through the proxy and then resolve to a project. Example trace `c-9a1f` shows both org and project counters +1.
lee: can you paste header dump?
morgan: headers: `X-Auth-Subject: token:abc`, `X-Origin-Org: org:acme`, `X-Resolved: project:acme-prod`, `X-Route: proxy-7`. Quota logs show meter labels `{billing_owner:org:acme}` and `{billing_owner:project:acme-prod}`.
samir: sounds like legacy behavior where we increment early for enforcement and again after attribution. That double-bills.
natalie: proposal: introduce a single canonical header `X-Canonical-Account` set after final resolution. Metering should prefer `X-Canonical-Account` for billing and treat other owner labels as lineage/debug.
morgan: +1. This preserves lineage for debugging but prevents double charging. Also add a debug metric `quota.canonicalization.mismatch` when both legacy and canonical owners differ.
lee: console impact: dashboards group by `billing_owner` label today. We need a short compatibility layer in the graphing backend to map `billing_owner` -> `X-Canonical-Account` alias during migration.
samir: rollout plan: 1) auth-router emits `X-Canonical-Account` behind feature flag `canonical_account_v1`, 2) meter-lib will prefer that header when flag enabled, otherwise fallback to existing labels, 3) emit mismatch metric, 4) canary across staging -> small prod subset -> full rollout.
natalie: tests: - request that triggers fallback should only increment canonical owner when flag on; - requests without header fallback to legacy - mismatch increments metric - billing-pusher dedupe unchanged
lee: add alert: if ratio `sum(canonical_billed)/sum(raw_billed)` deviates >3% in 1h after flip, auto-open incident.
dash-bot: deploy-bot: canary image `auth-router:canonical-header-canary` deployed to staging 08:40 UTC.
morgan: I'll open PRs for auth-router and meter-lib, include unit tests + an integration replay harness.
samir: console owners: please add an optional collapsed column "attribution_lineage" in quota table and a mapping fallthrough so historical panels keep working for 30 days.
console-bot: noted. We'll avoid showing lineage by default to prevent noise.
natalie: finance note: run a billing-simulator replay against last-week data before full rollout to catch any drift. Tagging @finance in the ticket.
lee: also add a debug endpoint to backfill recent traces with inferred `X-Canonical-Account` to speed triage. Make that job opt-in.
morgan: ticket created PLAT-4321 "Canonical account header + meter migration". I'll attach traces. Ping when PRs are ready. :thumbsup:
